status: EXPLORATORY modified representations -- NEVER original-SBG evidence; V10 is burned for these variants (designed after V10 results were seen)
populations_allowed: v9c_train (replication; nothing is fitted so train is not 'in-sample' for these fixed-weight variants)

return_value_sources.rv_abs100: multiset of (func_idx | _repr_to_abstract(repr(retval)[:100])) over every 'return' event; same abstraction domain + 100-char cap as the frozen state genome
return_value_sources.rv_abs_full: same, abstraction applied to repr capped at 1500 chars (more accurate collection-size classes)
return_value_sources.rv_type_abs: multiset of (func_idx | python-type-bucket | abstract value) -- distinguishes bool/int/list/str/... classes
return_value_sources.rv_hash: CEILING ONLY: multiset of (func_idx | md5(repr(retval))[:10]) -- concrete values; equals an output comparison on the protocol inputs
return_value_sources.rv_entry_hash: CEILING ONLY: as rv_hash restricted to the entry function -- label-oracle ceiling (label tautology), not a competitor

distance: frequency-weighted Jaccard on the multiset (identical formula to StateTransitionGenome.distance)
weights_rationale: fixed a priori (0.2 return-value share); NOT tuned; no weight sweep on RV is run
family_comparison: paired delta AUROC vs frozen V5 (S+RV_abs_full vs frozen State is reported as an additional descriptive comparison)
metrics: SC-6 AUROC vs all equivalent pairs
pass_criterion_none: no pass/fail criterion is claimed; results are descriptive feasibility evidence only
confirmatory_requirement: any claim about the RV variant requires a FRESH withheld set, a new freeze (config + code sha256 before scoring), scored once
